lines.zh: 我飘过去，斗篷底下没有脚。
lines.en: I drift past. There are no feet under the cloak.
The scythe drags the ground, scraping.

lines.zh: 我走的地方，草尖都垂下去。
lines.en: The grass bows where I pass.
I'm in no hurry. Every road ends.

lines.zh: 我经过一棵树，它就不响了。
lines.en: I pass a tree and its leaves go silent.

lines.zh: 我的斗篷里，什么都没有。
lines.en: There's nothing inside this cloak.
I walk toward the breathing.
The blade is darker than the night.

lines.zh: 一步一飘，地面都没踩实。
lines.en: A step, a drift. The ground is never pressed.
My cloak is full of wind.
I count how much road is left.

lines.zh: 经过的时候，会有一阵凉。
lines.en: A chill passes with me.
I stand there like a post.
No breathing under the cloak.

lines.zh: 镰刀在我手里，一直很轻。
lines.en: The scythe stays light in my hand.

lines.zh: 我等着，时间对我没意义。
lines.en: I wait. Time means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 夜风穿过去，斗篷鼓起来。
lines.en: The night wind goes through and the cloak swells.

lines.zh: 我在看，谁的气数快到了。
lines.en: I'm looking for who's nearly due.
I've done this work a long time.
I don't remember events. Only names.

lines.zh: 有的名字，我念了很多遍。
lines.en: Some names I've spoken many times.
No glint on the blade at all.
I raise my head. No face to see.
My shadow on the ground is blacker than night.
I wait for the sound of a lamp going out.
That breath always ends.
You're still breathing.
So it isn't time yet.
I look at you. Only look.
Your thread is still long.

lines.zh: 别怕我，我不是为你来的。
lines.en: Don't fear me. I'm not here for you.
Not tonight, at least.

lines.zh: 你退后，我闻得到你的热气。
lines.en: Step back. I can smell your warmth.
Don't look under the cloak.

lines.zh: 我的声音，你听着不舒服吧。
lines.en: My voice is unpleasant to you.
You get used to it.
What would you ask me?
I wouldn't answer anyway.
My scythe knows only the list.
If I say it, don't answer.
Answer, and it counts.
So. Say nothing.
I'll stand a while and go.
The scythe isn't for you.
Tonight you're lucky.
Go, before dawn.

lines.zh: 斗篷破了一道，里面是空的。
lines.en: A tear in the cloak. It's empty inside.
I don't hurt. I'm just slower.
That cost me time.
I right the scythe and walk on.
My cloak parts and your blow finds nothing.
I draw back and let you pass.
This will mend.
I don't bleed; only ash falls from me.
I'll come again. Not for you.
Don't follow. You can't.
I have no use for these.
Only the living get hungry.

lines.zh: 你的手一抖，气就散了些。
lines.en: Your hand shakes, and some of your warmth leaks away.

lines.zh: 我连影子都没有，怎么收东西。
lines.en: I have no shadow; how would I take anything.
Put it down. Don't waste it.
Keep your things.
That warmth won't last either.

lines.zh: 我见过太多人这样递东西。
lines.en: I've seen many offer things like this.
In the end, none of it helped.
Put your things away.
You passed through my cloak.
Where you touched will stay cold a while.

lines.zh: 我不占地方，可你别靠太近。
lines.en: I take no room, but don't come too near.
The scythe is beside you. Careful.
Two steps back. That will do.
I didn't push you.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞到了刃的侧面。
lines.en: Your shoulder met the flat of the blade.
No wound — that doesn't count.
Stand off. Don't lean close.
I don't want to take you now.

lines.zh: 斗篷里没有能给你的东西。
lines.en: There's nothing in my cloak to give you.
You're talking to a scythe.
I don't even have a face.

lines.zh: 站在这儿，你就不孤单了？
lines.en: Standing here — are you less alone?

lines.zh: 我的婚约，早就埋进土了。
lines.en: My betrothal was buried long ago.
You live. I work.
You being alive is enough.
Don't put your hand in the cloak.
Put your hand in. You'd regret it.
Go, before dawn.
The blade tips it up.
This isn't mine to take.
I nudge it aside so no one trips.

lines.zh: 地上东西多了，路不好走。
lines.en: Too much on the ground makes the road hard.
It's yours. I don't take it.
I hold it. No weight at all.
It doesn't go with the scythe.
I stand it by the stone.
This was in my way.
The road is cleared.
One breath is nearly out.
Not on your side.

lines.zh: 我的斗篷底下没有脚，镰刀拖地。
lines.en: No feet under my cloak; the scythe drags.
Someone over there is waiting.
I lift the scythe.
Blade down. That's the rule.
I won't hurry.
There's only one road.
It's already at the far end.
I only need to go over.
You needn't follow me on this one.
This isn't for you.
Someone is calling a name.
I know that name.
I lean toward the sound.
Not time to collect yet.
I follow that breath.
It grows thinner.
I don't need to look. I know the way.
At night all roads are the same length.
You're beside me. I don't mind.
Don't stand in between.
The scythe finds its place on its own.
A few steps to the far end.

lines.zh: 我握镰刀，从不用两只手。
lines.en: I hold the scythe with one hand, never two.

lines.zh: 风向变了，刃会自己修正。
lines.en: The wind shifts, and the blade corrects itself.
You may look away.
You needn't watch this one.
This errand is done.
The scythe lifts. Next.
Not you. Not tonight.
My cloak drifts ahead of me.
The road is underfoot. No need to look.
A lamp went out in one house.
I head that way.
The scythe hangs low. Not raised.
The scythe sweeps across. Lightly.

lines.zh: 你听不见它过来的声音。
lines.en: You won't hear it coming.
This cuts only what must be cut.
My cloak brushes your face.

lines.zh: 我没有碰你，是你撞上来。
lines.en: I didn't touch you. You came into it.
The blade met air. I held back.
You still breathe. So it's dropped.

lines.zh: 镰刃偏了半寸，我收回来。
lines.en: The scythe misses by half an inch; I draw it back.
This one doesn't count.
Remember. Don't come before me again.
I turn the blade a different way.
This one only makes you step back.

lines.zh: 斗篷卷过去，遮住你眼睛。
lines.en: The cloak sweeps past and covers your eyes.

lines.zh: 我收的是灵魂，不是尸体。
lines.en: I collect souls, not corpses.
I'm not here to fight.
Save your strength.
The cold arrives before I do.
The cloak separates itself from the dark.
The scythe touches down without a sound.
The grass bows. The wind stops.
I stand between you and the other one.

lines.zh: 这条路我走过很多次，石门还在。
lines.en: I have walked this road many times; the stone gate remains.
Tonight there is one name.
I won't say it.
Did you hear that sound?

lines.zh: 你听见的那一声，不是风。
lines.en: The sound you heard wasn't wind.
What arrived first was the cold.
I have a name and nothing to drop.
I am heading over there, do not follow.
No need to follow.
What's due always comes.
I never come early.
I don't come early, nor late.
Stand ready. Don't wander.
This night won't be short.

lines.zh: 我没有脸，你也看得出来。
lines.en: You can tell I've no face.

lines.zh: 火烧过斗篷，边卷起来了。
lines.en: Fire ran over the cloak. The edge curled.

lines.zh: 我坠进黑影，连风都没动。
lines.en: I sink into the dark without stirring the wind.
Water can't drown me either.
The blast scattered my shape.

lines.zh: 那东西穿过去，落在后头。
lines.en: It went through and landed behind.
This light is trying to hold me.

lines.zh: 镰刀没有刃，也照样收人。
lines.en: A scythe with no edge still reaps.

lines.zh: 雷落在镰刀上，我松了手。
lines.en: Lightning struck the scythe. I let go.
There's no road here.
